_note: Edited via the UI or manually. Applied by export_to_json.py before every export. Never overwritten by the pipeline.

company_merges._note: Format: {"alias": "canonical name"}. All connections at 'alias' are moved to 'canonical name'.

person_reassignments._note: Format: {"connection_id": "canonical company name"}. Overrides whatever company the pipeline detected.

change_rules._note: Controls what counts as 'obvious' vs 'ambiguous' when the CSV shows a company change.
change_rules._auto_apply_threshold_note: String similarity (0-1) below which a company change is flagged for approval. 0.45 means changes where new and old company names are less than 45% similar are auto-applied; more similar names get flagged as potentially ambiguous (e.g. 'EEI' vs 'Engineering Economics, Inc.'). Lower = approve more automatically. Higher = flag more for review.
always_auto_apply: _note: Company pairs where changes are ALWAYS auto-applied regardless of similarity
always_flag: _note: Company name fragments that should ALWAYS be flagged for review (e.g. known aliases)
